author: undergroundchar
text: That’s all well and good, but the programme has had trouble extracting Asus BIOS files for years. You can check this by downloading the BIOS for any Asus motherboard model – 7-Zip won’t extract it properly. An error will appear: "Some data is located beyond the end of the payload" However, if you use the built-in archiver in Windows 10/11, it will extract the Asus BIOS archive correctly.

text: The user interface is clean and minimalistic — not bloated at all. 7-Zip works excellently, and the 7z format is arguably the best available. However, I’ve been requesting a simple, user-friendly way to completely disable the folder history feature for a long time. Currently, the only method is by manually editing the registry, which isn't ideal. Implementing this feature wouldn't be difficult, but the developer has consistently ignored these requests. As a result, I would rate the support as poor.

text: We would have given 7-ZIP 5 stars, except that it sets the Windows archive bit even on archive files whose content hasn’t changed.
